name: Dennou Nap（仮眠圧縮）
description: CLMs思想のインテリジェント圧縮プラグイン：時間認識ブロック（章）分割 ＋ System 1 (Jev/Laya) による直感仕分け（維持・要約・落とす）＋ Historian 選抜一括要約。プロンプト先頭へのインメモリ合成のみでセッション JSONL は無傷。

endpoint.description: System 1 endpoint (Jev cloud default; Laya local e.g. http://localhost:8888/v1/systemone).

apiKey.description: API key for Jev. Optional for local Laya.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout ms for System 1 calls.

thresholdRatio.description: Auto-compaction trigger: usage tokens / context window at or above this ratio.

maxKeptRatio.description: Raw-data keep cap as a ratio of the model context window (contextWindow * maxKeptRatio). Oldest kept blocks are escalated to summary when exceeded.

protectRecentChapters.description: Trailing N chapters are kept 100% raw and excluded from triage/summarization (recent-chapter guard).

model.description: Model name for Historian summarization (reserved; auto path uses a deterministic excerpt to avoid re-entrant model calls).

maGapMs.description: Silence gap treated as a chapter boundary ("ma"). Default 5 minutes.

confidenceThreshold.description: Minimum System 1 confidence to trust the triage choice as-is.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive System 1 failures before the circuit opens.

cooldownMs.description: Circuit breaker cooldown ms before half-open.
